an3.39:1.2: mama sudaṃ bhikkhave pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti.
an3.39:1.3: ekattha sudaṃ uppalaṃ pupphati, ekattha padumaṃ, ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ, yāvadeva mamatthāya.
an3.39:1.4: na kho panassāhaṃ bhikkhave akāsikaṃ candanaṃ dhāremi. kāsikaṃ su me taṃ bhikkhave veṭhanaṃ hoti. kāsikā kañcukā, kāsikaṃ nivāsanaṃ, kāsiko uttarāsaṅgo.
an3.39:1.5: rattindivaṃ kho panassu metaṃ bhikkhave setacchattaṃ dhārīyati,
an3.39:1.6: mā naṃ phusi sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā rajo vā tiṇaṃ vā ussāvo vāti.
an3.39:2.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ, eko hemantiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.
an3.39:2.2: so kho ahaṃ bhikkhave vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi tūriyehi paricāriyamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohāmi.
an3.39:2.3: yathā kho pana bhikkhave aññesaṃ nivesanesu dāsakammakaraporisassa kaṇājakaṃ bhojanaṃ dīyati bilaṅgadutiyaṃ, evamevassu me bhikkhave pitu nivesane dāsakammakaraporisassa sālimaṃsodano dīyati.
an3.39:3.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evarūpāya iddhiyā samannāgatassa evarūpena ca sukhumālena etadahosi:
an3.39:3.2: ‘assutavā kho puthujjano attanā jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyati, harāyati, jigucchati, attānaññeva atiyitvā. ahampi khomhi jarādhammo, jaraṃ anatīto.
an3.39:3.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto, paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyeyyaṃ, harāyeyyaṃ, jiguccheyyaṃ, na me taṃ assa patirūpanti’.
an3.39:3.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado, so sabbaso pahīyi.
an3.39:4.1: assutavā kho puthujjano attanā vyādhidhammo samāno vyādhiṃ anatīto, paraṃ vyādhitaṃ disvā aṭṭīyati, harāyati, jigucchati, attānaññeva atiyitvā,
an3.39:4.2: ahampi khomhi vyādhidhammo, vyādhiṃ anatīto, ahaṃ ceva kho pana vyādhidhammo samāno vyādhiṃ anatīto, paraṃ vyādhitaṃ disvā aṭṭīyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ, na me taṃ assa patirūpanti’.
an3.39:4.3: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo ārogye ārogyamado, so sabbaso pahīyi.
an3.39:5.1: assutavā kho puthujjano attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇaṃ anatīto paraṃ mataṃ disvā aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati, attānaññeva atiyitvā
an3.39:5.2: ahampi khomhi maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto, ahaṃ ceva kho pana maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇaṃ anatīto paraṃ mataṃ disvā aṭṭīyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ, na metaṃ assa patirūpanti’.
an3.39:5.3: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo jīvite jīvitamado, so sabbaso pahīyīti.
an3.39:6.4: yobbanamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.39:6.5: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an3.39:6.7: jīvitamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.39:6.8: so kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā, manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an3.39:7.1: yobbanamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an3.39:7.2: ārogyamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakāya hīnāyāvattati,
an3.39:7.3: jīvitamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattatīti.
